caption: The drawing contains four rectangular samples of decorative patterns, arranged in a loosely vertical and horizontal alignment on a light cream background. The top rectangle features a brown background with vertical blue stripes, white branch-like patterns, and small oval shapes in blue, white, and brown. Below, the left rectangle is divided into three vertical sections: the leftmost has an intricate white vine pattern on a dark blue background, the middle section is a solid bright blue color, and the right section contains a detailed multicolored floral motif with red, blue, and yellow hues. To the right of this, the next rectangle displays a beige background with blue and yellow leaves, yellow, red, and brown line details, and alternating vertical bands of thin brown and thin red stripes. At the bottom, the largest rectangle is composed of a patchwork design with squares and rectangles in brown, blue, red, yellow, and beige, each containing ornate floral and scroll motifs. The patterns utilize colors including blue, brown, white, yellow, red, and beige, and are rendered in a style suggestive of textile or wallpaper designs. The name "Albert Loomis" is inscribed in the lower right corner of the page.
title: Cotton Prints
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
